تحتاروا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَارُوا (taḥtārū) /taħ.taː.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَارَ (iḥtāra)
# تُحْتَارُوا (tuḥtārū) /tuħ.taː.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَارَ (iḥtāra)
